Volibear|jgl.identity: Mixed damage fighter-tank. Thundering Smash (Q) speeds him up toward champions and stuns with his next attack, Frenzied Maul (W) marks, then heals him if he hits again, Sky Splitter (E) calls down a lightning bolt that slows (and shields him if he's inside the zone), and Stormbringer (R) makes him leap while disabling towers. In the jungle, he maxes Q to gank.
Volibear|jgl.playstyle: Gank and tower-dive jungler. Volibear reaches lanes fast thanks to Q and dives with his ultimate.
Volibear|jgl.early_game: Clear with E and W. Gank when your laner can follow up: Q to speed up and stun, W to heal. Avoid duels against assassins and junglers who kite you.
Volibear|jgl.level_2: Frenzied Maul (W). Mark, then heal: your clear gets healthier.
Volibear|jgl.level_3: Thundering Smash (Q). First gank: Q → attack (stun) → W → E on yourself for the shield. Q is maxed first.
Volibear|jgl.level_6: Stormbringer: a leap that disables towers. Dive under towers with your laners for guaranteed kills, or engage in teamfights.
power_spikes: First completed item: strong ganks and dives.
Volibear|jgl.jungle_plan: Safe clear and ganks from level 3. After 6, set up tower dives with your laners thanks to your ultimate. Control Scuttles, Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. Avoid duels against mobile or ranged junglers (Talon, Quinn, Bel'Veth).
Volibear|jgl.trading: Ganking: Q → stun → W → W again on the marked target. Diving: R on the tower → Q → W. Give up on it against champions who kite or dodge you.
threats: Talon, Quinn and Bel'Veth: hard matchups.
Dives without follow-up from your laners.
mistakes: Diving under a tower without your ultimate to disable it.
Engaging with Q when you can't follow up.
Forgetting to stand inside Sky Splitter for the shield.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Stun him with Q when he engages.
matchup_notes.Viego: Stun him before he possesses your allies.
matchup_notes.Talon: He bursts you and escapes over walls.
matchup_notes.Quinn: She kites and blinds you: avoid her.

Volibear|jgl.late_game: Engage on the enemy backline with your ultimate, Q to stun the carry.
Volibear|jgl.ahead: Dive under towers with your laners and take objectives.
Volibear|jgl.behind: Farm and play for engages in teamfights.
Volibear|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to gank and tower-dive with your ultimate to create advantages.
Volibear|jgl.final_tip: Save your ultimate for dives: it disables towers for a few seconds.
